rules.title: ruff format and --fix
rules.text: Use ruff format as the formatter and ruff check --fix for autofixable lint.

rules.title: Config in pyproject
rules.text: Keep Ruff settings in pyproject.toml or ruff.toml under the lint and format tables.

rules.title: Choose rules deliberately
rules.text: Choose rule families with select or extend-select rather than enabling everything.

rules.title: Scoped ignores
rules.text: Scope exceptions with per-file-ignores for tests, scripts and __init__.py instead of global ignores.

rules.title: noqa with a code
rules.text: Use # noqa with a specific rule code, only where unavoidable.

rules.title: Unfixable rules
rules.text: List rules you do not want auto-fixed under unfixable.

rules.title: Notebook exceptions
rules.text: Relax noisy rules such as print checks for notebooks through per-file-ignores.

rules.title: CI and hooks
rules.text: Run ruff check and ruff format --check in CI and through pre-commit so local and CI results match.

rules.title: Target version
rules.text: Set requires-python or target-version so Ruff applies the right syntax rules.
